page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn1ne.2xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz, delivering 8 dedicated physical cores and 8 vCPUs with 1 thread per core. The instance is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 2.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and it operates with a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate that the ecs.sn1ne.2xlarge sits primarily in the lower performance tiers for modern workloads. Its single-core and multi-core CPU performance, as measured by stress-ng and Geekbench, falls into the bottom 25% and bottom 10% categories respectively. However, it demonstrates average performance in Passmark CPU tests and extended instruction execution. Memory bandwidth tests show average capabilities for large-block read and write operations, though small-block cached reads remain weak. For specialized tasks, the instance achieves average speeds during small 135M model LLM inference but struggles with larger 7B models.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.sn1ne.2xlarge offers a budget-friendly entry point for legacy x86_64 applications that require dedicated CPU allocation without the premium cost of newer generation hardware. Given its lack of local storage and modest network baseline, it is best suited for lightweight web serving, basic application hosting, and non-intensive background processing tasks where high-speed I/O and massive memory footprints are not required.
